Complete occluded, back, side and underside regions using {'type': 'repeated_modules', 'completionRule': '按可见方格模块重复延伸完整沙发'} and ['补充完整座面与侧面模块']. Texture rule: 方格绗缝软包纹理; 延续方格绗缝纹理，保持均匀排布. Target plausible real-world dimensions are approximately 1.90 m wide, 0.95 m deep and 0.85 m high. Preserve the corresponding width-to-depth-to-height proportions. These are category-prior estimates rather than pixel measurements. Use conservative category structure, repeated modules, continuous closed geometry, and one 45-degree product view on a plain light background. Keep only the main object.
